title: RTPS: Fix missing port in LOCATOR_KIND_UDPV6
description:
UDPv6 locators are missing the port field.
Modified rtps_util_add_locator_t so that UDPv6 locators interpret the
port, just as in the case for LOCATOR_KIND_UDPV4.

notes.body:
**Current behavior:**

![locator_missing_port](/uploads/f8552bc2322640c4e3812632aea6aecf/locator_missing_port.png)

**After fix:**

![locator_missing_port_fixed](/uploads/817718710a5a7f57892c644582a80514/locator_missing_port_fixed.png)

**Specification:** [DDS-RTPS 2.3](https://www.omg.org/spec/DDSI-RTPS/2.3/PDF). See section 9.4.2.10 LocatorList.

![locatorList](/uploads/a4b01eaed35f99d17003a75dfb0bdb10/locatorList.png)
